content.short: Catapult connects people across the Web3 ecosystem to join, explore, and connect with others.
content.description: Catapult connects people across Web3. For Community Managers, the platform helps design onboarding flows with bespoke user journeys and provides a robust member management dashboard that lets you filter, cluster, and connect with members in targeted ways. For Contributors and Members, Catapult offers rich profiles and discovery tools to surface interesting connections within your own community and with peers in other communities.
content.meta: Catapult helps people connect and engage across the Web3 ecosystem. Discover Catapult and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
